verdict.rationale: DBOS documents starting workflows in the background (DBOS.start_workflow), cron-scheduled workflows that can be created, paused and resumed at runtime, and queues with managed concurrency. Interrupted workflows recover automatically, including via Conductor failover to a healthy executor, and agent workflows can wait hours or days without supervision. Community users report running production pipelines on it, such as an exactly-once Kafka event pipeline and workflows with tens of thousands of steps. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled or background runs specifically, and setup requires writing annotated code rather than configuring automations directly.
